policy: V17 adds a content-addressed liquidity.policy/v1 and a non-authorizing distribution.capacity-replay/v1. Capacity is derived from restated realized P&L, original sealed retention/loss/buffer policy, restated HardNAV and post-distribution liquidity headroom. Current LCR alone never authorizes distribution.

additions.authority_note: Content-addressed 1w/4w/8w minimum LCR and liquidity-surplus floors. V1 models a cash distribution as immediate reduction of available resources across all horizons. Policy has no authorization or execution authority.

Reference-only replay of maximum distribution capacity after historical restatement. Capacity = min(realized-profit budget, HardNAV solvency headroom, post-distribution liquidity headroom), with original invariant failures forcing NO_ACTION until separate reevaluation. It cannot authorize, pay or execute a distribution.
